verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs say its AI assistants file employee reimbursements automatically, and that reimbursements are paid to local bank accounts, so a reimbursement flow to bank accounts exists. Nothing documents the turnaround or status tracking. Missing for 10: explicit out-of-pocket expense submission flow, direct-deposit payout timing (reimbursed in days), submission-to-payout status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout

citations.quote: AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.
Pay your global statements and reimbursements to and from local bank accounts to avoid intercompany transactions and accelerate payments.
